products.displayTitle: Circular drum lamp shade kits 20cm diameter x 18cm
products.bodyHtml:
Custom 20cm Drum Lampshade Kit

Create a professional, bespoke lampshade that perfectly complements your home decor.


What size will my covering need to be?
Your covering needs to be 645mm wide x 220 mm to cover the self-adhesive panel supplied 


What type of lamp holders will fit this lampshade?
The frame is manufactured to fit European lamp holders, and a Converter/Reducer Adaptor plug is supplied fitted to reduce the aperture
so it can fit UK lamp holders. 


Lampholder Types
B22 Bayonet Cap  Lampholders (UK) -  Adaptor Fitted
E14 Edison Screw Lampholders  (EU)    Adaptor Fitted
E27 Edison Screw Lampholders  (EU)    Adaptor Removed
E26 Edison Screw Lampholders  (US)    Adaptor Removed


Harp & Finial Fittings
If you wanted to use the frame with a Harp & Finial fittings, used mainly in the USA, then you can use converting washers with our adaptor (purchased separately) to reduce the aperture further. For more details about the Converter / Adaptor system, click here.



What's in the box
1 x Lampshade ring, epoxy coated
1 x Lampshade ring, epoxy coated with fitting
1 x Self-adhesive lampshade panel size 646mm x 210mm includes 15mm kiss cut.
1 x 2mtr roll self-adhesive tape
1 x Rolled Edge tool for finishing



Specifications
Your lampshade can be used in Europe and the UK (includes converter plug)

Lampshade Assembled Size
20cm Diameter x 18cm High

Lining Colour
White (see options)

Bulb Advice
We recommend the use of low energy bulbs with your lampshades. They use less energy and are cool to the touch, avoiding the problem of scorching shades and ceilings.

Testing
Our lampshade materials have been tested and passed the glow wire test carried out by the Lighting Association.
Contact us for test certificates.

Box Dimensions
Packed in individual box 235mm x 230mm x 55mm
      
How to Order
Select "Add to Cart" at the top of this page

products.bodyHtml:
Custom 30cm Drum Lampshade Kit

Create a professional, bespoke lampshade that perfectly complements your home decor.

Whether you want to match your curtains, upholstery, or wallpaper, this versatile kit allows you to design a high-quality 30cm Drum Lampshade. It is engineered for use as either a ceiling pendant or with a table lamp.

📏 Fabric & Covering Requirements

To ensure a perfect fit for the included self-adhesive panel, your chosen material should meet the following dimensions:

• Required Size: 970mm wide x 255mm high

🔌 Universal Fitting Compatibility

This kit is designed for global compatibility. The frame natively fits European hardware, but includes a Converter/Reducer Adaptor to accommodate 


| Fitting Type | Region | Instructions |
|---|---|---|
| **B22** Bayonet Cap | UK | Keep Adaptor Fitted |
| **E14** Edison Screw | EU | Keep Adaptor Fitted |
| **E27** Edison Screw | EU | Remove Adaptor |
| **E26** Edison Screw | US | Remove Adaptor |
> **Note for US Harp & Finial Systems:** To use this shade with a standard American Harp & Finial fitting, you will need to use converting washers (available separately) in conjunction with our adaptor system.
>

To use this shade with a standard American Harp & Finial fitting, you will need to use converting washers (available separately) in conjunction with our adaptor system.

 

📦 What’s Included in Your Kit

Everything you need to achieve a showroom finish:

• 2 x Epoxy-Coated Rings: One standard ring and one fitted with the lamp attachment.

• 1 x Self-Adhesive Panel: Precision cut to 966mm x 240mm (includes a 15mm "kiss cut" for easy finishing).

• 1 x Adhesive Tape: A 3-meter roll of high-tack tape.

• 1 x Rolled Edge Tool: For tucking fabric perfectly behind the rings.

Handmade Lamp Shades Made to Order

We offer a wide range of handcrafted lamp shades, crafted with meticulous attention to detail by our skilled artisans. Our selection includes drum, oval, hexagonal, tapered, empire, cone, tall, coolie, and many more unique shapes.

All sizes are available upon request. Each lamp shade is meticulously hand-made, using exclusively one-of-a-kind fabrics that undergo special printing on demand.

We strongly advise customers to carefully verify sizes and shapes before placing an order.

For US customers, please note that our sizes are measured in centimetres, not inches. We can provide a set of washers to accommodate US harp fitting lamps.

Additionally, if customers are solely interested in checking patterns or colours, we recommend ordering samples or selecting a single shade at a time.
